items.title: Stella Lefty’s Personality Vacuum
items.summary: "Boston," the breakout single by country-ish singer-songwriter Stella Lefty, sounds like an inevitable hit because it already was one. The song, a pleasant ditty about taking a chance on love, includes an interpolation of Noah Kahan's massive hit "Stick Season." That helped "Boston" become massive itself: on TikTok and social media, as well as the more traditional venues of airplay on pop and country formats across the country. (If you're wondering, Boston is being very normal about this.) The post Stella Lefty’s Personality Vacuum appeared first on Stereogum .
